subject: Consolidated partner roundtable — availability and single invite
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kevin Lopez <kevin@openapps.com>, Anna Zhou <anna@clearsky.ai>, partners@acme.com
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated partner roundtable — availability and single invite

Hi Kevin, Anna, and team,

Thanks for your interest in a joint walkthrough of the Redwood Inference platform. A few of our prospective partners asked if we could run a single "partner roundtable" session this quarter instead of individual 1:1s — same content, interaction across teams, and a short breakout for use-case questions. Our ask: one 60-minute group session with the following agenda (attached): quick intro, demo of serving/runtime features, cost/scale discussion, and 15 minutes for Q&A.

Prospective slots (all PT):
- Tue May 4, 10:30–11:30 AM PT
- Wed May 5, 2:00–3:00 PM PT

If neither works, please reply with 1–2 windows that work for your group. If you'd prefer a shorter 30-minute session with a follow-up deep-dive, tell us and we can adjust.

Attachments: roundtable_agenda.pdf

Next steps: once we confirm a slot, I’ll send a single calendar invite and a short attendee list so we can coordinate breakout topics.

Thanks — looking forward to bringing the groups together.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

The May 5 mid-afternoon slot looks better for our engineering lead, but we have a hard constraint: could we consider a 30-minute focused walkthrough (demo + Q&A) instead of the full hour? If the group wants breakouts afterwards we can coordinate follow-ups.

Prefer: Wed May 5, 2:00–2:30 PM PT (if others can accommodate).

Thanks,

Thanks for the quick reply Kevin — and thanks Monica for kicking this off.

Quick proposal to make scheduling easier:
- Run a 30-minute consolidated demo (35 minutes to allow buffer) focused on serving/runtime highlights and one customer use case.
- Follow with optional 30-minute breakout rooms for product or infra deep-dive for teams that sign up.
- I'll spin up a short Doodle poll (link below) that captures timezone prefs + breakout interest; please add who will attend from your side so we can finalize an attendee list.

Doodle poll: https://doodle.com/poll/roundtable-availability-xyz
Attachment: attendee_list.csv (please add attendee names + roles in the file if you want us to pre-assign breakout rooms).

If everyone can fill by EOD Friday, we’ll pick the slot and I’ll send a single Google Calendar invite to the confirmed list.

Thanks — Rachel

All — thanks for filling the poll. Based on responses, we’ve locked the session:

Wed May 5, 2027 | 2:00–2:30 PM PT (30 minutes) — consolidated demo + Q&A
Optional breakouts: 2:35–3:05 PM PT (sign up in attendee list)

Google Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123roundtable
Attachments: roundtable_agenda.pdf, slide-deck-v2.pdf

Agenda highlights:
- 5m quick intros
- 10m live demo: predictive routing + KV-cache optimization vignette
- 10m cost/perf levers + quantization recommendations by workload
- 5m open Q&A

Karthik will run a short infra-level breakout focusing on Dedicated vs Private deployment options — Karthik, can you confirm you’ll lead the breakout room?

Once attendees accept the calendar invite we’ll share a meeting notes doc and breakout assignments.

Best,
Monica
